messages:
tyler: starting post-deploy ramp check for release r-2026.03.21 — will run smoke suite across eu/us. change window ends 02:00 UTC. tagging infra on-call.

deploy-bot: deploy r-2026.03.21 -> canary groups finished. traffic shifted 25% -> 100% over 10m. automated synthetics: 98/100 ok, 2 warnings (embed p95). Logs: `synth-checker: WARN embed_p95=312ms threshold=300ms`

anna: sending quick health checks now, curl to /health on eu and us.

anna: eu: `{
  status: "ok",
  agents: 42,
  model_variant: "redwood-v2-q8",
  kv_cache_hit: 0.87
}`

sanjay: us-west seems fine, p50/p95 stable. saw one 503 from gateway at 15:43 but it recovered. stacktrace link: https://logs.redwood/inference/trace/abc123

margaret: just ran the end-to-end smoke (short prompt -> completion) against the new routing policy, samples look good. posting one sample: `> prompt: "Summarize this" -> token_count 24, latency 178ms` :thumbsup:

tyler: noted the synth warnings. anna/sanjay can you capture a quick histogram of embed latency for last 30m? we want to check if it's a tail or constant bump.

anna: histogram attached (short link) — looks like tail spike near 300-350ms on eu1, most under 180ms. could be warmstart artifacts. :eyes:

deploy-bot: quickcheck metrics: cpu 62%, gpu_mem 74%, enqueue depth 3, prefix_cache_miss_rate 0.06. Canary version pinned: redwood-v2-q8@2026-03-21-1

sanjay: i'll keep an eye on the gateway 503s for 10m. if embed_p95 > 320ms for 3 consecutive windows (5m windows) we hold and roll back to previous variant.

margaret: leaving a note in release_notes.md: "observed transient embed p95 tail on eu1 during ramp; monitoring/mitigation in place."

tyler: if no further regressions in 15m we proceed to full rollout and close the change window. ping me with :rocket: when you see stable metrics.

anna: +1. current plan: 15m observe, if stable, finalize rollout. otherwise pause and escalate.

sanjay: rolling-monitor active. will call for rollback if threshold breached.

deploy-bot: action recorded: postdeploy-ramp-sanity-handoff created, owners: tyler/anna/sanjay, followup: decide by 5367895221.

tyler: thanks team — keep short updates here.
